question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a orange present, Bob has a blue present, Claire has a purple present, Dave has a silver present, Eve has a yellow present, Fred has a teal present, and Gertrude has a brown present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Eve and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Dave swap their gifts. Finally, Bob and Dave swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Eve has the
Options:
(A) orange present
(B) blue present
(C) purple present
(D) silver present
(E) yellow present
(F) teal present
(G) brown present
solution:
Present colors in each row are listed in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: orange, blue, purple, silver, yellow, teal, brown
1. Eve and Bob swap: orange, yellow, purple, silver, blue, teal, brown
2. Dave and Alice swap: silver, yellow, purple, orange, blue, teal, brown
3. Alice and Fred swap: teal, yellow, purple, orange, blue, silver, brown
4. Dave and Fred swap: teal, yellow, purple, silver, blue, orange, brown
5. Claire and Gertrude swap: teal, yellow, brown, silver, blue, orange, purple
6. Fred and Dave swap: teal, yellow, brown, orange, blue, silver, purple
7. Bob and Dave swap: teal, orange, brown, yellow, blue, silver, purple
Eve has the blue present, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
